candidates: In GitHub Actions workflows that use `actions/setup-node`, always specify the Node.js version via `node-version-file:` pointing to the project's canonical version file (e.g., `node-version-file: '.node-version'`, or `node-version-file: 'package.json'` if a `volta.node` field is present) rather than hardcoding a version string inline. This keeps all workflows automatically in sync with the project's intended Node version and avoids drift across multiple workflow files.
